text:
lina_cs: Quick heads-up — SpecterFold (onboarding) needs a JP region allowlist + temporary rate bump for a live demo tomorrow 09:00 JST. They said they'll run ~2000 reqs over 30m. Also noting account flagged for renewal risk (low usage last 30d).
ashley_net: Copy. Do they have static egress IPs we can whitelist or do we need header allowlist?
kai_specterfold: hi! we can provide a CIDR and a fallback header token if needed. CIDR: 203.0.113.0/27. demo traffic originates from our staging cluster in tokyo.
miguel_ops: ok. For a temporary qps bump we'll need start/end times, CIDR, and whether they need burst or sustained increase. what's the expected p95 latency requirement?
kai_specterfold: aim is <150ms p95. Start 2026-03-24T09:00:00+09:00, duration ~45m. burst to 120 req/s, sustained 50 req/s.
lina_cs: adding renewal note — account hasn't used prod in 3 weeks. They're on a quarterly plan, renewal in 6 weeks. CS wants to do an enablement walkthrough after demo.
ashley_net: I'll prep a short allowlist rule. Miguel — want me to open a temporary rule scoped to tokyo region with auto-expire + revoke?
miguel_ops: yes please. auto-expire and ticketed. Also add a fallback to route to lower-cost model if latency spikes.
ops-bot: Created ticket CS-5621: "SpecterFold JP allowlist + transient rate bump" (expires 2026-03-24T10:00:00+09:00). Assigned miguel_ops.
lina_cs: thanks. Can we also capture their feedback form after the demo? low usage + renewal risk -> bundle a success playbook and a 1:1.
miguel_ops: will instrument a short eval endpoint for them and enable prefix KV caching for staging key to lower token spend during demo.
kai_specterfold: appreciated. Can you confirm header token payload we should send?
ashley_net: use header X-RW-CUSTOMER: specterfold-demo and X-RW-DEMO: true. We'll whitelist header + CIDR.
lina_cs: i'll schedule the enablement 1:1 for next week and mark renewal as "engaging". I'll also add a quick checklist in CS notes: demo outcome, latency, errors, ask for committed usage.
miguel_ops: done — rule pushed to tokyo-edge (allow CIDR, header pair). fallback route configured: model-small on latency breach >250ms. caching enabled. ticket updated CS-5621.
ops-bot: Reminder scheduled 10 minutes before start for CS on-call.
kai_specterfold: perfect — we'll send a final smoke test at 08:30 JST. thanks team :raised_hands:
